items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: MacDowell, Adirondacks type of thing with MacDowell, Eastwood Lane, the harmonies, the type of harmonies, beautiful thing and the development of any thematic material.

ctx.x: No, that's what I said. There was just the name, which I have seen mentioned when musicians from that period we are talking about, their interests in the French impressionists, then Eastwood Lane's name would come up and I had never heard any of the things.

I think Eastwood Lane and Beiderbecke were strictly American, not New York American. You know, MacDowell, Adirondacks type of thing with MacDowell, Eastwood Lane, the harmonies, the type of harmonies, beautiful thing and the development of any thematic material. Well, you're familiar with Bix's things.
